newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber offer prices were unchanged in late trading on Friday with no buying interest, traders said.
"We did not record any fresh deals. Prices stayed the way they were since the morning," said one trader.
"We expect that prices will at least stay the same next week but the chance for prices to fall is quite high due to poor market sentiment," he added.
Traders said SIR20 offer prices were quoted at 46.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang for July shipment after an overnight deal there.
Offer prices were unchanged at 46.50 fob Medan, at 46.50 fob Padang and Surabaya and at 46.00 fob Pontianak.
Traders said offer prices were unchanged at 45.75 fob Jambi.
